title: Mirzapur: The Movie
synopsis: The battle for Mirzapur's throne escalates as old enemies resurface and new threats emerge. Blood debts must be paid while power-hungry contenders fight to control the city's violent underworld.

synopsis_lang.en: The battle for Mirzapur's throne escalates as old enemies resurface and new threats emerge. Blood debts must be paid while power-hungry contenders fight to control the city's violent underworld.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 米爾札布爾的王座之爭愈演愈烈，昔日宿敵重現，新興威脅亦接踵而至。嗜血的舊債終須償還，而各路權力野心家爭相廝殺，只為掌控這座城市暗黑地下世界的命脈。

cast: Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal, Jitendra Kumar
